answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh signal challenge every epoch. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the forge of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. The river is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal n8rqb.
